label: exploratory verification and planning run, protocol unfrozen, not a finding
hypothesis: Verification checks V1-V6 of research/experiments/EXP-001/protocol.md pass; measure runtime per run, projected full-matrix runtime, between-seed SD of the SIM minus RAND drift difference, and degenerate cells
commands: PYTHONPATH=src uv run --frozen python -m echo.cli smoke --trace-memory (memory measurement, superseded outputs)
PYTHONPATH=src uv run --frozen python -m echo.cli smoke (cross-process determinism check, uncommitted code)
PYTHONPATH=src uv run --frozen python -m echo.cli smoke (recorded run at commit b2e9738)
PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m echo.cli report results/exploratory/EXP-001
config: experiments/EXP-001/config.json (blocks smoke 20 runs, pilot 20, timing 10, sensitivity_screen 36; timing and sensitivity_screen are additions to the draft EXP-001 protocol)
outcome: 86/86 runs ok, 0 failed. V1-V6 all pass; result files also byte-identical across three separate processes (shasum diff). Pilot (10 seeds, full size, adaptive eta 0.05): SD of paired SIM-RAND drift difference 0.01587 rad; projected 95% t half-width 0.01135 rad at n=10, below SESOI/2 = 0.025, so 10 seeds are adequate. Runtime per full-size run (machine shared with concurrent sessions, load average 20-36): RAND 1.15 s, POP 1.49 s, SIM 2.40 s, MMR 2.11 s, EXPLORE 2.85 s; projected EXP-002 200 s, EXP-003 639 s single-process. Peak traced memory at most 13.6 MiB per full-size run (tracemalloc run); process max RSS 186 MiB. Degenerate cases: skip rate near zero for RAND, SIM, MMR, EXPLORE (at most 0.022) under skip_utility 0; RAND drift reaches 1.33-1.36 rad under consumed or exposure rules at eta 0.2; no listener frozen at zero drift under the bounded rule; no run without acceptances.
hardware: Apple M1 Pro, 10 cores, 16 GiB, macOS 15.3.1
interpretation: Planning values only. The pilot mean difference is not interpreted (see progress.md).

label: exploratory calibration fit on real data (FMA metadata), protocol section 10.1; not a finding
hypothesis: None. Fit K, cluster weights and Zipf s on the FMA training split by the method written into research/protocol.md 10.1 before fitting (commit a843fd4); build the EXP-004 real catalogue from the test split.
commands: python3 scripts/download_fma_metadata.py
PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -I scripts/build_fma_catalogue.py (run twice; outputs byte-identical)
code_revision: a843fd4 plus the uncommitted ingestion code committed with the freeze (src/echo/fma.py, scripts/build_fma_catalogue.py)
primary_contrast_used: No. The fit reads FMA metadata only; no simulation, policy or seed is involved. One structural check built a 1000-track real catalogue at exploratory seed 900000 (shapes, genre counts, popularity sum); no listener was simulated.

hardware: Apple M1 Pro, 10 cores, 16 GiB, macOS 15.3.1
